the BHA so as to minimize the possibility of large volumes of cuttings settling during connections, causing packing off and stuck pipe. Prior to trips the hole should be circulated for at least bottoms up, this will often prevent tight hole on the way out and bridges, fill etc. on the way back in. Pumping of highly viscous pills may be necessary to flush the hole correctly. Tight hole and/or washing and reaming on tr

ht will be increased steadily. Again, optimum use of all solids control equipment should be made. However, cuttings at the shale shakers should be monitored for signs of cavings that may indicate need for an increased mud weight.
